name: value-utilities/borders
description: Border family. The `border-` prefix is the gnarliest in Tailwind: `border` alone is `border-width: 1px` (theme.borderWidth.DEFAULT), `border-2` is width=2px, `border-blue-500` is color, `border-t-2` is top width=2px, `border-t-blue-500` is top color. Multi-match prefix lookup walks both width and color entries; the first that resolves wins. Plus `rounded-*` (border-radius with per-side `rounded-l/r/t/b` and per-corner `rounded-tl/tr/bl/br/ss/se/ee/es`), `border-solid|dashed|dotted|double|hidden|none` statics, arbitrary widths and radii.
